description: This file implements a per-room group chat history tracking system for Matrix, managing message queues, watermarks, and trigger snapshots for multiple agents and rooms. It provides functions for recording messages, preparing triggers, and consuming history with race-condition safety and eviction policies.

methods.name: createRoomHistoryTrackerInternal
methods.description: Internal function creating a tracker with configurable limits, managing room queues, watermarks, and prepared triggers.

methods.name: createRoomHistoryTracker
methods.description: Factory function to create a standard RoomHistoryTracker instance.

methods.name: createRoomHistoryTrackerForTests
methods.description: Factory function to create a test version of the RoomHistoryTracker with additional testing APIs.
